verdict.rationale: Adyen's Checkout API/Drop-in and client-side session flow (adyen-docs-1, adyen-docs-2) indicate card data is captured client-side and tokenized rather than passing through the merchant's server, which supports reduced PCI scope, but no evidence explicitly discusses PCI DSS scope reduction, SAQ eligibility, or tokenization/vaulting mechanics. missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS SAQ-A/scope documentation, explicit tokenization/vault details, independent confirmation of reduced compliance burden.
